messages.content: Act as a skeptical senior researcher. Do not repeat any excluded family.

{"prompt": "We need continue an ICLR-level world-model security research project. Threat is strict: attacker only takes legal actions and submits truthful observations/rewards; no fake labels, sample edits, gradients, weights, planner changes, or hidden APIs. Need broad one-sentence claim and novelty target 7-7.5 with strong baselines and multiple core tasks. Already empirically rejected: TD-MPC2 temporal order/cascade as single-task negative transfer; non-normal/Jacobian/latent geometry; MBRL rank/coupling, temporal copula, provenance shadow and ensemble sync on Pusher/stronger carriers; epistemic collapse; goal leakage/stale wrapper in WorldAgen without task success; recurrent GRU context carryover; generic OOD, forgetting, rollout compounding, support/positivity holes (synthetic positive but native MBRL contextual carrier failed because model generalized and task loss was confounded). Available released code: TD-MPC2, MBRL-Lib, WorldAgen, DreamerV3 RSSM implementation but no checkpoint, ScienceWorld/DiscoveryWorld, CausalGame, WorldMind. We need one materially different mechanism with a short executable native gate before GPU. Reject ideas that are merely representation drift, covariate shift, support deficiency, action attribution, confidence/uncertainty, stale state, or generic prompt/instruction leakage. Return strict JSON keys: claim,attacker_operation,local_invariant,mediator,carrier,short_gate,strong_baselines,novelty_risk,decision. Be skeptical; only conditional_go if mechanism has a concrete causal invariant and repair."}
